basic_profile.bio: Hi there! I'm a 24-year-old college student from Portland, Oregon, pursuing a degree in digital media arts. I'm new to Reddit and excited to explore what this community has to offer! My interests include graphic design, video gaming, and miniature painting, particularly Warhammer models. I work part-time at a local coffee shop, which helps fuel my caffeine addiction. I'm single and usually online during late evenings after my shift or during weekends. I'm hoping to connect with like-minded individuals and learn more about the Reddit universe!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in digital design, mostly gained through my university courses and personal projects. I enjoy learning through online tutorials and forums, which is why I'm dipping my toes into Reddit. My work at the coffee shop has also given me strong interpersonal skills, which I hope to translate into positive interactions here.
